snippet.title: Sliding Blaster 2 - September 2025 demo
snippet.description:
Some gameplay from a top-down mouse-controlled SNES homebrew shooter game which I worked on in June and August, mostly. I posted a build for people to try at https://forums.nesdev.org/viewtopic.php?p=304207#p304207

Sound effects are placeholders.
